verdict.rationale: Founder Law describes itself on its own pages as a U.S. law firm and contrasts itself with automated form tools, saying complex founder cases need an attorney accountable for the outcome. It also offers attorney consultations and full legal defense for RFEs/NOIDs, which supports an attorney-led, not unsupervised-form-service, model. Missing for 10: no named lawyers or bar credentials in the evidence, no explicit statement that a licensed attorney serves as attorney of record who prepares and signs each petition, and no independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service
